summary: Keep Claude child lifecycle events within their native session

replay.detail: No claim replay or retained lifecycle history changes. The local Claude ledger rejects foreign or missing native-session identity on nonboundary events.

schema.detail: No database schema, versions, migrations, tables or indexes change.

rules.detail: Existing child lifecycle leases, checkpoint rules and fleet coordination contracts are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Claude child/turn/end hooks must name the current native session once the ledger knows it; child starts require a native session ID. Valid older hook payloads retain their existing common session_id field. No client, wire field, claim kind or production launch settings change. Codex capture and the existing child lease contract are unchanged.

downtime.detail: The regression coverage introduces no production service interruption.

manual.detail: No manual schema or starting-version transitions are required. This source guard does not rewrite launch settings retained by existing harness processes.

recovery.detail: No production recovery or database swap-back behavior changes.
